_comment: INTENT gold set. Unlike questions.json (pure term-overlap), these queries are answered by CONTEXT: recency, importance, reinforcement, or task-relevance — the signals plain keyword/FTS5 cannot see. relevant_ids were labeled BLIND, by the intent of each query against the corpus text/metadata, before running any ranker (see benchmarks/BENCHMARKS.md and crates/memorywhale-core/examples/README.md). task_tags exercise the builtin task-relevance signal.
